Let's look at the linear model output

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Select the predictors for the initial model
model_data <- training_data %>%
  select(
    Goals,
    HomeAway,
    PDSF,
    PDSCF,
    PDR,
    PDW,
    PDD,
    PDL,
    Round,
    Days,
    DWF,
    DLF,
    DDF,
    DGSF,
    DGCF,
    DAS,
    DDS
  )

# Poisson doesn't know what to do with NA values, so clean the data
model_data <- na.omit(model_data) 

poisson_model <- glm(
  Goals ~ .,
  data = model_data,
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

summary(poisson_model)

model_data$predicted_goals <- predict(
  poisson_model,
  newdata = model_data,
  type = "response"
)

mae <- mean(
  abs(model_data$Goals - model_data$predicted_goals)
)

rmse <- sqrt(
  mean((model_data$Goals - model_data$predicted_goals)^2)
)

mae
rmse
```
Pretty far off..

```{r}
poisson_data <- training_data %>%
  select(
    Goals,
    HomeAway,
    PDSF,
    DGCF,
    DAS,
    DDS
  )

# Poisson doesn't know what to do with NA values, so clean the data
poisson_data <- na.omit(poisson_data) 

poisson_model <- glm(
  Goals ~ .,
  data = poisson_data,
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

summary(poisson_model)

poisson_data$predicted_goals <- predict(
  poisson_model,
  newdata = poisson_data,
  type = "response"
)

mae <- mean(
  abs(poisson_data$Goals - poisson_data$predicted_goals)
)

rmse <- sqrt(
  mean((poisson_data$Goals - poisson_data$predicted_goals)^2)
)

mae
rmse
```
```{r}
features <- training_data %>%
  select(
    PDSF, PDSCF, PDR, PDW, PDD, PDL,
    Round, Days,
    DWF, DLF, DDF, DGSF, DGCF,
    DAS, DDS
  )

correlation_matrix <- cor(
  features,
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

round(correlation_matrix, 2)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(
  training_data,
  aes(x = HomeAway, y = Goals)
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Team's venue",
    y = "Goals scored",
    title = "Distribution of goals scored by venue"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
